== Description ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] (left, navy Philadelphia Union jersey, white/grey hair, back to camera), [[Jordan Gosiaco]] (mid, curly hair, brown shirt), [[Karl Koenig]] (standing, far background, yellow graphic tee), and [[Bill Kafer]] at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
